steps.prop: Eqt K (div (plus a b) c) (plus (div a c) (div b c))
Eqt K (div (plus b a) b) (plus 1 (div a b))
Eqt K (div (plus a b) b) (plus (div a b) 1)
Eqt K (times (times (div 1 a) (plus a b)) (div 1 b)) (plus (div 1 a) (div 1 b))
Eqt K (plus b (div a c)) (div (plus (times b c) a) c)
Eqt K (plus (div a c) b) (div (plus a (times b c)) c)
Eqt K (plus (div a b) (div c d)) (div (plus (times a d) (times b c)) (times b d))
steps.by: rw [add_div, mul_div_mul_right _ b hd, hbc.eq, hbd.eq, mul_div_mul_right c d hb]

steps.prop: Eqt K (plus (div 1 a) (div 1 b)) (div (plus a b) (times a b))
steps.by: rw [(Commute.one_right a).div_add_div hab ha hb, one_mul, mul_one, add_comm]

steps.prop: Eqt K (plus (Inv__inv K a) (Inv__inv K b)) (div (plus a b) (times a b))
Eqt K (div (plus a a) 2) a
Eqt K (plus (div a 2) (div a 2)) a
Eqt K (div a (Neg__neg K a)) (Neg__neg K 1)
Eqt K (div (Neg__neg K a) a) (Neg__neg K 1)
Eqt K (minus (div a c) (div b c)) (div (minus a b) c)
Eqt K (div (minus b a) b) (minus 1 (div a b))
steps.by: simpa only [← @div_self _ _ b h] using (div_sub_div_same b a b).symm

steps.prop: Eqt K (div (minus a b) b) (minus (div a b) 1)
steps.by: simpa only [← @div_self _ _ b h] using (div_sub_div_same a b b).symm

steps.prop: Eqt K (times (times (div 1 a) (minus b a)) (div 1 b)) (minus (div 1 a) (div 1 b))
iff (Eqt K (Inv__inv K 0) 0) (or (Eqt K 0 (Neg__neg K 1)) (or (Eqt K 0 0) (Eqt K 0 1)))
iff (or (Eqt K a 1) (Eqt K a (Neg__neg K 1))) (or (Eqt K a (Neg__neg K 1)) (or (Eqt K a 0) (Eqt K a 1)))
iff (or (Eqt K a 1) (Eqt K a (Neg__neg K 1))) (or (Eqt K a (Neg__neg K 1)) (or (Eqt K a 0) (Eqt K a 1)))
iff (Eqt K a (Inv__inv K a)) (or (Eqt K a (Neg__neg K 1)) (or (Eqt K a 0) (Eqt K a 1)))
Eqt K (minus (div a b) (div c d)) (div (minus (times a d) (times b c)) (times b d))
steps.by: simpa only [mul_neg, neg_div, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using hbc.neg_right.div_add_div hbd hb hd

steps.prop: Eqt K (minus (Inv__inv K a) (Inv__inv K b)) (div (minus b a) (times a b))
steps.by: simp only [inv_eq_one_div, (Commute.one_right a).div_sub_div hab ha hb, one_mul, mul_one]

steps.prop: Eqt K (minus a (div a 2)) (div a 2)
Eqt K (minus (div a 2) a) (Neg__neg K (div a 2))
Eqt K (minus (Inv__inv K a) (Inv__inv K b)) (div (minus b a) (times a b))
steps.by: rw [inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div, div_sub_div _ _ ha hb, one_mul, mul_one]

steps.prop: Eqt K (minus b (div a c)) (div (minus (times b c) a) c)
steps.by: simpa using div_sub_div b a one_ne_zero hc

steps.prop: Eqt K (minus (div a c) b) (div (minus a (times c b)) c)
steps.by: simpa using div_sub_div a b hc one_ne_zero
